svg.text: V4 smart suit — pod wiring (PCB v4.0)
Each pod board: every connector, pin by pin, to the part it plugs into · all JST-PH 2.0 mm unless noted · XIAO ESP32-C6 in every pod except the cuff
XIAO C6 + GY-521 + GY-68 on sockets
set 3.3 V · EN tied to VIN on the module
battery % to the hub and cuff
Suit wiring through the 6 snaps on the back:
under the arm, in the lining
Reed switch at the zip top
magnet in the puller: closed = LOW
no MCU — on the core's I²C bus
elbow end · same pin = same wire
On the board: 1.3" OLED (GND VCC SCL SDA — check yours) · MAX30102 underneath (VIN SCL SDA … GND)
LiPo on the XIAO BAT pads:
u.FL → FPC antenna in the lid
MAX98357A soldered low: LRC BCLK DIN GAIN SD GND VIN=BAT+ · 28 mm 8 Ω 1 W speaker on its terminal
D0 FSR (10 k to GND, ADC)
D3 IMU_INT · D4 SDA · D5 SCL
LiPo on the XIAO BAT pads
Helmet and boot pods are separate XIAO C6 nodes that talk to the core over ESP-NOW (suit key). Only the cuff is wired (6-core sleeve cable).
Every pod charges from the dock through its magnetic pogo socket (5 V). The core charges at 1 A (TP4056), helmet / boot through the XIAO's own charger.
Bring-up: modules out, power on, check 3.3 V on the core J11 pin 3 (and 5 V / BAT on the small pods) before fitting the XIAO and modules.
